meta.note: Source is a 2026 big-game cosmetics spot (124 s) parodying a telenovela; brand, star and product names are slots. Spanish dialogue is given in English.

acts.name: Cold open: the drive
acts.function: Ident, then the setup in one radio line (tonight is the biggest show) against her confession (she doesn't speak the language), and a crash.

acts.name: Opening titles
acts.function: Soap-opera credits on crimson satin: star super, then the heroine's name as the show's script title.

acts.name: The hospital
acts.function: She wakes, the show is tonight, she can't speak; the heartthrob doctor prescribes the lip gloss (the plot twist).

acts.name: Training montage
acts.function: Speech therapy as melodrama: practice words, swoons, a jealous rival, failure.

acts.name: Transformation and party
acts.function: One more coat of gloss: she nails the words, turns diva in gold and the whole hospital dances.

acts.name: Title and cliffhanger
acts.function: Product title card (she kisses the gloss under her own script name); the rival steals it: 'To be continued...'

sound.music: Telenovela score throughout: a dramatic theme under the titles and the title card (10.4-18.4, 109.4-115.6), a soft romantic bed under the hospital dialogue, a reggaeton dance track from 97.4 to about 109 (party), a logo sting at 121.3. Tempo detected 115 bpm (bar 2.087 s).
sound.speech: Spoken on camera and as VO, mixed in the soundtrack: the announcer (ident, radio, title name), the heroine (comic panic, failed then perfect Spanish practice words), the doctor (slow, seductive, mock-grave). Spanish words in the source are given in English in the line text.
sound.mix: Dialogue forward (-15 to -20 LUFS mean per shot), music under; the crash scream peaks at -5.5 dB; the dance section is loudest (-7 to -11 LUFS).
sound.name_mutes: The shipped set/score.wav and lines have the brand word (0.30-1.05) and every spoken name of the heroine/star (11.35-12.65, 13.75-15.75, 16.20-17.20, 24.95-25.64, 110.22-111.68) muted to silence with 20 ms ramps; a new film records its own brand and heroine name in those windows.

look.grade: Glossy soap-opera video look: warm, creamy, slightly high-key interiors with soft pastel sets (peach hospital room, mint physio room, cream-and-blush lobby); saturated crimson for the title cards; the night drive is cool dark teal-grey.
look.brightness: Night car shots sit at 30-37 (headlight flash to 73); hospital and physio interiors 85-145 (macros 84-90, wide rooms 105-130); lobby 100-140; title cards on crimson satin 54-71; ident cards black with a crimson glow at 31-41.
look.contrast: Medium-low; soft rolled highlights, open shadows (TV drama lighting).
look.light: Big soft window-style keys, flattering beauty light on the heroine, practical warm lamps; no hard shadows except the headlight flash.
look.depth_of_field: Shallow on close-ups and inserts (normal-long lenses), deep on the wides.
look.grain: Clean digital, no visible grain; a light glow/bloom on the title cards.
look.colour: Heroine's pinks and gold against mint, peach and cream sets; the product is the hottest pink in every frame.

text_style.ident: Lowercase thin high-contrast Didone wordmark in deep crimson (#8c1030) on a white TV-screen-shaped badge, 'PRESENTS' in small bold spaced caps; badge centred, 25% of frame width; crimson radial glow on black.
text_style.title: Soap-opera script title: flowing copperplate with a big looping capital, polished silver chrome with bevel and glint, slanted ~15 degrees, about 53% of frame width, left of centre, writing on left to right in about 1.3 s.
text_style.credit_super: (not in the cuts) silver small-caps serif name super with a drop shadow, left third ('{ACTRESS} ES').
text_style.cliffhanger: (not in the cuts) light italic script 'To be continued...' lower right, fading with the picture.
text_style.case: lowercase wordmark; script title in title case

char_heroine.fixes: The comedic leading lady, an invented woman: early 50s, curvy full figure, light olive skin, oval face with high cheekbones, dark brown almond eyes, strong arched brows, a small beauty mark above the left corner of her upper lip, long voluminous chestnut-brown glamour waves with a deep side part; soap-opera makeup, glossy rose lips. Big comic eyes, diva poise. Four looks (wardrobe sheet panels 1-4): 1 car: dusty-pink chunky cardigan + cream high-neck floral-embroidered blouse; 2 hospital: pale-blue gown with pink/navy diamond print; 3 transformed: liquid gold lame gown, puffed shoulders, gold coil cuffs, gold collar, door-knocker earrings, hair teased huge; 4 title card: blush satin blouse with ruffled jabot.

char_doctor.fixes: The heartthrob doctor, an invented man: early 40s, tall, slim-athletic, warm tan skin, thick black wavy hair swept back with silver temples, dark brooding eyes, short neat black stubble beard; white lab coat open over a pale-blue shirt open two buttons, thin gold chain, steel watch, plain navy badge with a white caduceus icon and no text.

char_extras.fixes: Lobby dancers: nurses in light-blue scrubs (a young woman with a curly high puff, a slim young man with a stethoscope, a tall bald older man, a middle-aged woman with gold hoops) and a burly moustached security guard in a grey uniform shirt, black tie, plain red shoulder patch.

product_gloss.fixes: The {PRODUCT}: a generic liquid lip gloss, small square clear thick-walled glass vial about 5 cm tall with a thick clear base, filled with glossy raspberry-pink gloss (#e0245e; reads deeper red #c8102e on the crimson title card), matte black square cap about 2.5 cm tall, white stem, slanted doe-foot applicator. No label, no print (the sheet's view captions are not on the product).

loc_car_night.fixes: An older dark grey SUV at night on a dark suburban street, beige-grey cloth seats; very dark (picture brightness about 30).

loc_hospital_room.fixes: Soap-opera private hospital room: bed with plump white pillows, peach walls, rust-brown drapes over white sheers, wall light box with two blue x-rays (skull, hand), monitor, pink-rose bouquet, gold swan ornament; bright warm (110-140).

loc_physio_room.fixes: Physiotherapy room: mint-green walls, teal curtains, wooden wall bars, a teal exercise ball on a silver-grey ball on a black stand, dark-green medicine-ball rack, grey treatment table, wooden practice stair, pastel seascape prints; soft daylight (about 115).

loc_hospital_lobby.fixes: Warm hospital lobby: curved cream reception counter with pink trim, blush/cream walls, small pink arrow signs (no words), table lamps, plants, wheelchairs, IV pole; golden light (about 115).

loc_title_backdrop.fixes: Crimson satin backdrop for the title card, soft folds, pink bloom upper left (#6b1a20 to #c23a4a).

ui_ident.fixes: The ident: two striped TV-screen shapes (shutter), then the white TV-shaped badge with the lowercase Didone wordmark (default 'rosabel') + 'PRESENTS' (opening) or wordmark only (end card), crimson radial glow on black.

ui_title.fixes: The script title lettering: '{HEROINE}' (default 'Marisol') in silver chrome copperplate on crimson satin.

lines.fixes: Every kept spoken line, cut from the soundtrack (music under), with word times; the guide audio for speaking shots and the timing target.

voices.fixes: Timbre: heroine 9.9 s (comic, bright, mid-low, a little breathless), doctor 12.4 s (slow, warm baritone, seductive, mild accent), announcer 4.8 s (radio-promo energy; there is no more clean announcer speech in the film).

cut30.arc: Hook (0-10.05): the ident ('{BRAND} presents'), then night in the car: the radio promises tonight's world's biggest reggaeton show, she blurts 'I don't speak Spanish!', the radio says 'unforgettable', headlights, snap zoom, scream. Middle (10.05-18.92): smash cut to the plot twist: the heartthrob doctor uncaps a lip gloss, 'Normally, I wouldn't do this, but you need juicy lips so you can roll those R's,' and glides it onto her lips. Payoff (18.92-25.18): transformed in gold she nails 'Cheese, fire, cheese, fire!' and the whole hospital lobby dances. Title + end card (25.18-30.0): she kisses the gloss under her own script title, then the {BRAND} TV-badge ident.
cut30.note: Score joins: 10.052, 18.922, 23.096, 25.183, 27.792 (timeline). cut15.arc: Hook (0-4.38): in the car at night she blurts 'I don't speak Spanish!' as the radio promises an 'unforgettable' show; headlights, snap zoom, scream. Proof (4.38-6.98): the doctor uncaps the lip gloss: 'Normally, I wouldn't do this...'. Payoff (6.98-10.64): transformed in gold she nails 'Cheese, fire, cheese, fire!'. cut15.note: The 30 s cut tightened: no ident opener, the car starts on the radio's last words, the gloss proof is the uncapping insert only, no dance party. Score joins at 4.375, 6.984, 10.636, 12.723; 36.661 and 121.183 are pickup beats (see cut30). Segments sum to exactly 15.0.
